title: Crexi Commercial Real Estate Scraper Input
description: Configure the scraper to extract commercial real estate listings from Crexi.com. Provide search result URLs or direct property URLs to start scraping.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: List of Crexi.com URLs to start scraping from. Can include search result pages or direct property listing URLs. The scraper will automatically detect the page type and handle accordingly.

maxCrawlPages.title: Max pages to crawl
maxCrawlPages.description: Maximum number of property detail pages to scrape. Use this to limit the number of results.

maxCrawlDepth.title: Max crawl depth
maxCrawlDepth.description: Maximum depth of links to follow from the start URLs. Depth 0 means only start URLs, depth 1 includes pages linked from start URLs, etc.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of pages to process concurrently. Higher values = faster scraping but more resource usage. Recommended: 3-10.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings to use for requests. Using proxies is highly recommended to avoid being blocked by Crexi.com.

waitForDynamicContent.title: Wait for dynamic content (seconds)
waitForDynamicContent.description: Additional time to wait for Angular/JavaScript content to fully load on each page. Increase if data is missing.

includeDetailedKeyValues.title: Include all property details
includeDetailedKeyValues.description: Extract all key-value pairs from the property details table (e.g., Zoning, Tenancy, etc.). This provides more comprehensive data.

debugMode.title: Debug mode
debugMode.description: Enable verbose logging for troubleshooting. Logs will include detailed information about page loading and element extraction.
